blocks.text: OSLO, Norway—Norway‘s main media organizations said Tuesday they had taken legal action to block Meta from enforcing new user terms, which they claim threaten their rights to their journalistic content. According to the 10 media groups, the new terms due to come into force on November 20 would give Meta the right to collect their articles, photos and videos, and use them to develop artificial intelligence products, among other things. They said the materials include those behind a paywall.
